metadata.description: The Microsoft Sentinel workspace into which the function will be deployed. Has to be in the selected Resource Group.
The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 ImagesAndImportExport activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AttachImageWatermark", "Set", "AMI Watermark",
    "BundleInstance", "Execute", "EC2 Instance",
    "CancelBundleTask", "Delete", "Bundle Task",
    "CancelConversionTask", "Delete", "Conversion Task",
    "CancelExportTask", "Delete", "Export Task",
    "CancelImageLaunchPermission", "Delete", "AMI",
    "CancelImportTask", "Delete", "Import Task",
    "CopyFpgaImage", "Execute", "FPGA Image",
    "CopyImage", "Execute", "AMI",
    "CreateFpgaImage", "Create", "FPGA Image",
    "CreateImage", "Create", "AMI",
    "CreateImageUsageReport", "Create", "Image Usage Report",
    "CreateInstanceExportTask", "Create", "Instance Export Task",
    "CreateRestoreImageTask", "Create", "AMI",
    "CreateStoreImageTask", "Create", "AMI",
    "DeleteFpgaImage", "Delete", "FPGA Image",
    "DeleteImageUsageReport", "Delete", "AMI Usage Report",
    "DeregisterImage", "Delete", "AMI",
    "DescribeBundleTasks", "Read", "Bundle Task",
    "DescribeConversionTasks", "Read", "Conversion Task",
    "DescribeExportImageTasks", "Read", "Export Image Task",
    "DescribeExportTasks", "Read", "Export Task",
    "DescribeFastLaunchImages", "Read", "AMI",
    "DescribeFpgaImageAttribute", "Read", "FPGA Image",
    "DescribeFpgaImages", "Read", "FPGA Image",
    "DescribeImageAttribute", "Read", "AMI",
    "DescribeImageReferences", "Read", "AMI",
    "DescribeImageUsageReportEntries", "Read", "AMI Usage Report",
    "DescribeImageUsageReports", "Read", "AMI Usage Report",
    "DescribeImages", "Read", "AMI",
    "DescribeImportImageTasks", "Read", "Import Image Task",
    "DescribeImportSnapshotTasks", "Read", "Import Snapshot Task",
    "DescribeStoreImageTasks", "Read", "Store Image Task",
    "DetachImageWatermark", "Delete", "AMI Watermark",
    "DisableAllowedImagesSettings", "Disable", "AMI",
    "DisableFastLaunch", "Disable", "AMI",
    "DisableImage", "Disable", "AMI",
    "DisableImageBlockPublicAccess", "Disable", "AMI",
    "DisableImageDeprecation", "Disable", "AMI",
    "DisableImageDeregistrationProtection", "Disable", "AMI",
    "EnableAllowedImagesSettings", "Enable", "AMI",
    "EnableFastLaunch", "Enable", "AMI",
    "EnableImage", "Enable", "EC2 Instance",
    "EnableImageBlockPublicAccess", "Enable", "AMI",
    "EnableImageDeprecation", "Enable", "AMI",
    "EnableImageDeregistrationProtection", "Enable", "AMI",
    "ExportImage", "Execute", "AMI",
    "GetAllowedImagesSettings", "Read", "AMI",
    "GetImageAncestry", "Read", "AMI",
    "GetImageBlockPublicAccessState", "Read", "AMI",
    "GetImageFindings", "Read", "AMI",
    "ImportImage", "Create", "AMI",
    "ImportInstance", "Create", "EC2 Instance",
    "ImportSnapshot", "Create", "EBS Snapshot",
    "ImportVolume", "Create", "EBS Volume",
    "ListImagesInRecycleBin", "Read", "AMI",
    "ModifyFpgaImageAttribute", "Set", "FPGA Image",
    "ModifyImageAttribute", "Set", "AMI",
    "RegisterImage", "Create", "AMI",
    "ReplaceImageCriteriaInAllowedImagesSettings", "Set", "AMI",
    "ReplaceImageInstanceTypeSpecification", "Set", "AMI",
    "ResetFpgaImageAttribute", "Execute", "FPGA Image",
    "ResetImageAttribute", "Execute", "AMI",
    "RestoreImageFromRecycleBin", "Set", "Snapshot"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName == "AttachImageWatermark", ResponseElements.watermarkKey,
      EventName in ("BundleInstance", "CancelBundleTask"), ResponseElements.bundleInstanceTask,
      EventName == "CopyFpgaImage", ResponseElements.fpgaImageId,
      EventName in ("CopyImage", "CreateImage", "CreateRestoreImageTask"), ResponseElements.imageId,
      EventName == "CreateFpgaImage", ResponseElements.fpgaImageGlobalId,
      EventName == "CreateImageUsageReport", ResponseElements.reportId,
      EventName == "CreateInstanceExportTask", ResponseElements.exportTask,
      EventName == "EnableAllowedImagesSettings", RequestParameters.AllowedImagesSettingsState,
      EventName == "ExportImage", ResponseElements.s3ExportLocation,
      EventName == "ImportImage", ResponseElements,
      EventName in ("ImportInstance", "ImportVolume"), ResponseElements.conversionTask,
      EventName == "ImportSnapshot", ResponseElements.snapshotTaskDetail,
      EventName == "ModifyFpgaImageAttribute", ResponseElements.fpgaImageAttribute,
      EventName == "ReplaceImageInstanceTypeSpecification",
        coalesce(RequestParameters.instanceTypeSpecification, RequestParameters.InstanceTypeSpecification),
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName in ("AttachImageWatermark", "DetachImageWatermark", "GetImageFindings",
        "ReplaceImageInstanceTypeSpecification"), coalesce(RequestParameters.imageId,
        RequestParameters.ImageId),
      EventName == "BundleInstance", RequestParameters.InstanceId,
      EventName == "CancelBundleTask", RequestParameters.BundleId,
      EventName in ("CancelConversionTask", "DescribeConversionTasks"), RequestParameters.ConversionTaskId,
      EventName in ("CancelExportTask", "DescribeExportTasks"), RequestParameters.ExportTaskId,
      EventName in ("CancelImageLaunchPermission", "DeregisterImage", "DescribeFastLaunchImages",
        "DescribeImageAttribute", "DescribeStoreImageTasks", "DisableFastLaunch", "DisableImage",
        "DisableImageDeprecation", "DisableImageDeregistrationProtection", "EnableFastLaunch", "EnableImage",
        "EnableImageDeprecation", "EnableImageDeregistrationProtection", "ExportImage", "GetImageAncestry",
        "ListImagesInRecycleBin", "ModifyImageAttribute", "ResetImageAttribute", "RestoreImageFromRecycleBin"),
        RequestParameters.ImageId,
      EventName == "CancelImportTask", ResponseElements.importTaskId,
      EventName == "CopyFpgaImage", ResponseElements.fpgaImageId,
      EventName in ("CopyImage", "CreateImage", "CreateRestoreImageTask", "ImportImage", "RegisterImage"),
        ResponseElements.imageId,
      EventName == "CreateFpgaImage", ResponseElements.fpgaImageGlobalId,
      EventName == "CreateImageUsageReport", ResponseElements.reportId,
      EventName == "CreateInstanceExportTask", ResponseElements.exportTask.exportTaskId,
      EventName == "CreateStoreImageTask", ResponseElements.objectKey,
      EventName in ("DeleteFpgaImage", "DescribeFpgaImageAttribute", "DescribeFpgaImages",
        "ResetFpgaImageAttribute"), RequestParameters.FpgaImageId,
      EventName == "DeleteImageUsageReport", RequestParameters.ReportId,
      EventName == "DescribeBundleTasks", ResponseElements.bundleInstanceTasksSet,
      EventName == "DescribeExportImageTasks", RequestParameters.ExportImageTaskId,
      EventName in ("DescribeImageReferences", "DescribeImageUsageReportEntries", "DescribeImageUsageReports",
        "DescribeImages"), RequestParameters.ImageId.N,
      EventName in ("DescribeImportImageTasks", "DescribeImportSnapshotTasks"),
        RequestParameters.ImportTaskId.N,
      EventName in ("ImportInstance", "ImportVolume"), ResponseElements.conversionTask.conversionTaskId,
      EventName == "ImportSnapshot", ResponseElements.snapshotTaskDetail.snapshotTaskDetailId,
      EventName == "ModifyFpgaImageAttribute", ResponseElements.fpgaImageAttribute.fpgaImageId,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
